The illustration and reference entries are not product test results. Learn about Unique Packaging and discuss the final specification with our team. Plan the coffee pack Specify whole beans or ground coffee, roast-to-pack timing and target shelf life. Confirm whether a degassing valve is needed and request its specification separately. Check fill volume with your actual coffee; a nominal gram size does not establish the right pouch dimensions. Check the bottom gusset Confirm the bottom gusset, filled footprint and stability at the intended fill level. Keep artwork clear of the base fold and seals. Review the filled sample against shelf depth before fixing the dieline. Review the final heat seal Heat sealing is the recorded closing direction. Confirm seal width, film compatibility and the settings for the intended filling line. If repeat opening is required, specify a separate reopening or reclosing feature. Resolve the material references The material and film entries describe different levels of detail or alternative options. Choose one final layer structure in the quotation; do not combine the lists into an assumed laminate. Confirm layer order, thicknesses, sealant and the testing needed for the intended contents. Confirm size and measurement basis The thickness reference is 50–200 µm (measurement basis to be confirmed). Confirm usable internal dimensions and test the intended fill quantity with the actual contents; weight, volume and flat dimensions are not interchangeable. Approve the artwork and print route Share artwork status, the number of designs and quantity per design. Ask the quotation to identify the selected printing and finishing processes rather than assuming every listed reference applies.
